data.name: Infiniterra
data.detailed_description:
A voxel sandbox focused on atmosphere and contrast. Explore layered worlds, face eerie nights and caves, and shape your own path through an immersive environment.

A World of Layers

Explore a world built on cubic chunks that extends far beyond the surface in all directions. From floating sky islands to deep underground realms, each layer introduces new environments, resources, and challenges. Additional systems like custom portals are planned to further expand travelling options.

Atmosphere First

The game is built around contrast: calm and cozy during the day, but tense and unsettling at night. Caves are designed to feel genuinely eerie, encouraging careful exploration rather than routine mining.

Dynamic Lighting & Sound

Advanced lighting and a growing ambient soundscape bring the world to life. Dynamic lights, shadows, and environmental audio aim to create a strong sense of place, making each area feel distinct and immersive.

Meaningful Progression

Progression is centered around tools, workstations, and materials that gradually unlock access to new layers of the world. These systems are already in place and will be expanded over time. Equipment choices, such as armor weight, are intended to support different playstyles from fast and agile to slower and more tanky.

Creative Building Freedom

Build using a flexible voxel system with a focus on more open block placement. Additional features and quality-of-life improvements are being added to expand on familiar sandbox building mechanics.

Immersive Multiplayer (Planned)

Multiplayer is planned for a later stage of development. This includes built-in proximity voice chat, with audio effects reacting dynamically to the environment, such as cave reverb or underwater muffling.

Modding-Friendly by Design

Core systems such as voxel data, crafting recipes, and items are already defined in simple JSON structures. Making these systems more accessible for players is planned, with the goal of supporting easy modification and a strong modding ecosystem.

Early Access & Ongoing Development

The game is actively in development, with core systems still evolving. Feedback will directly influence future features, content, and overall direction. Please refer to the Early Access section for more details.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (DX12 or Vulkan)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD required.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD required.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Any modern 64-bit Linux distribution
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (Vulkan support!)
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Tested on recent Ubuntu and Mint versions. SSD required.
